register.category_reading: The FALSIFY-MONO-011 register category, written in monorepo_invariants.rs as 'publish = false thin MCP servers whose capability IS a protocol surface', is read as 'publish = false deployment-unit binaries', because the endpoint is an IAM-invoke Lambda transport and not an MCP server. Plan 11-06 amends the comment and the assertion message in the same change.
